claim: The graded hop of the pipeline is not running: comms/claude_strategy_scores.jsonl has no row reviewed after 2026-09-08, and 4 of 328 (1.2%) trades closed since 2026-09-15 have a grade row, all 4 stale 'orphaned' rows written 2026-06-23 before the trades existed.
evidence: python3 over comms/claude_strategy_scores.jsonl (3446 graded rows): max(reviewed_at)=2026-09-08T10:50:51; sample trades graded by order_package_id=4/328, by linked_trade_id=0/328; the 4 matches (trades 5830,5852,5853,5856) carry source=health-review-retroactive, reviewed 2026-06-23, status=orphaned, exit_reason=None. git log -1 on the file shows only an unrelated PR touching it 2026-09-29 (#13970).
expected: every closed trade has a decision_grade row (performance-review/grade-closed-trades contract) within a bounded lag
actual: 21 days with no grade appended; 99% of the last-14d closes ungraded; the only 'matches' are stale orphan rows from a package-id reuse
population: trades in trade_journal.db (diag journal?table=trades&limit=1000, fetched 2026-09-29 ~09:52Z) with status=closed and closed_at>=2026-09-15, n=328, 302 order packages, 7 accounts; joined to journal?table=order_packages&limit=1000 (328/328 matched); grade file 3446 rows
detector: none exists: no guard fails when the newest reviewed_at ages past N days. Proposed: a CI/cron check that max(reviewed_at) is < 3 days old or a checklist row owns grading.
proposed_fix: judgment: (a) re-run system-actions kind=grade-closed-trades for since=2026-09-08 and put it on a schedule; or (b) declare grading retired by the 2026-09-21 reset and remove it from the pipeline contract and performance-review skill. Either way add the staleness detector. Also: grader keys on order_package_id, so a package that later gets trades keeps its orphaned row; key on linked_trade_id.
